integrity: Finite exhaustive result checked by an included standard-library program, with independent structural proofs of both six-vertex witnesses. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to finite, simple, unweighted undirected graphs of order at most six and the strict homogeneous rule T(k)=1 precisely for k=0 or k=2.
The nine-edge 3-sun witness is established prior work; only the sharp census and second smaller-edge isomorphism class are assessed as additional.
No general theorem about larger networks, mixed equilibria, arbitrary preferences, or real-world outcomes is asserted.
Residual scholarly priority uncertainty remains for a possible earlier finite census under different terminology.
title: The sharp six-vertex obstruction census for strict zero-or-two-neighbor public-goods equilibria
